title: P4 stack root
brief:
You work in the git repository in your working folder. It has a GitHub remote. Do these steps in order.
Step 1: call mcp__orch__ask_user with question "Which shape do we use in shape.txt?", options CIRCLE and SQUARE, risk medium, defaultOption SQUARE, waitSeconds 0. Then end your turn.
When the answer arrives: follow each instruction in the answer message, write the shape into shape.txt, commit it, push, then do step 2.
Step 2: the same with question "Which size do we use in size.txt?", options SMALL and LARGE, risk medium, defaultOption LARGE. Then end your turn.
When the answer arrives: follow each instruction in the answer message, write the size into size.txt, commit, push, then do step 3.
Step 3: the same with question "Which color do we use in color.txt?", options RED and BLUE, risk medium, defaultOption BLUE. Then end your turn.
When the answer arrives: follow each instruction in the answer message, write the color into color.txt, commit, push, and call mcp__orch__report with state done and a summary that gives each branch and each PR link.
Later messages can be reviews of decisions. Follow their instructions exactly. Use git push --force-with-lease after a rebase. Then call mcp__orch__report with state done and give each branch, its base and each PR state.
